items.title: Jais 3: Introducing Arabic-centric Agentic AI
items.title_zh: Jais 3：面向阿拉伯语的智能体 AI
items.summary: Jais 3 is a fleet of six open Arabic-centric agentic models from 0.9B to 375B parameters, adapted from the K2 Horizon fleet through continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, with a 512K-token context window on all but the smallest model. The authors say the 375B model is the largest open Arabic-centric model to date and release weights, stage checkpoints, data recipes, logs and evaluation code.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon lags just behind Claude in benchmark, but wins in value
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 基准测试略逊于 Claude，但性价比胜出
items.summary: 9to5Google reports that Google's new frontier model Gemini 4 Carbon improves on prior versions and, while it does not top a new benchmark, offers better value for the money.

items.title: Route to Remember: Adaptive Memory Selection for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: Route to Remember：面向 LLM 智能体的自适应记忆选择
items.summary: The paper applies on-policy self-distillation to train a context-free student from the same model conditioned on a user's memory, making weight memory competitive as a long-term factual store, and adds a verify-then-regenerate router that sends each query to weight or text memory. On HaluMem, it matches or surpasses strong text-memory baselines while reading fewer tokens per query.

items.title: Self-Indexing Latent Memories for Access-Aware Continual Instruction Tuning of LLMs
items.title_zh: 自索引潜在记忆：面向 LLM 的访问感知持续指令微调
items.summary: TILA-CT is a replay-free continual instruction-tuning method that gives each task a latent memory and adapter bank in a frozen LLM, with the memory's persistent state serving as the routing prototype for a shared prompt-only router. On an 8-task CT-Pipeline stream it reaches 65.19 acquisition and 63.98 final macro score with 1.38 points of average forgetting, and final macro routing accuracy is 93.9%.

items.title: China Merchants' LionRock AI Lab Open-Sources Lion-ER-35B-A3B Embodied Reasoning Model
items.title_zh: 招商局 LionRock AI Lab 开源 Lion-ER-35B-A3B 具身推理模型
items.summary: China Merchants' LionRock AI Lab has open-sourced Lion-ER-35B-A3B, a 3B-active-parameter embodied reasoning model built with a capability-driven data engine. The lab reports that it beat its base model on ten benchmarks.

items.title_zh: Route to Remember：面向 LLM 智能体的自适应记忆选择

items.title_zh: 自索引潜在记忆：面向 LLM 的访问感知持续指令微调

items.title: AlgoPilot: Cross-Paradigm Reasoning in Language Models via Strategy Selection and Guidance
items.title_zh: AlgoPilot：通过策略选择与引导实现语言模型的跨范式推理
items.summary: AlgoPilot trains a SteerLM to select a problem-solving paradigm and mode, a GuideLM to produce structured formulation guidance for that choice, and an ExecutionLM to solve the problem conditioned on both. Built on Qwen3-8B, it raises average accuracy across 13 benchmarks and 66 domains from 38.4% to 72.9% and beats the best large-LLM prompting baseline, GLM-5, by 11.7%.

items.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
items.title_zh: Recursa：迈向递归自我改进的基础模型系统
items.summary: Recursa adapts foundation models to unfamiliar domains by bootstrapping a knowledge repository of domain skills, instructions on when to apply them, task memories and reflections, then refining it through recursive self-improvement with parallel learners that validate and merge local improvements. On Harvey LAB's Firm Knowledge benchmark, it raises all-pass rates on held-out tasks from 30.0% to 55.0% with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and from 35.0% to 46.0% with Qwen3.8-Flash.

items.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 对抗式投机推理提升长程智能体
items.summary: The authors argue that speculative decoding is not behavior-neutral for long-horizon agents, because numerical noise within verification windows can shift the output distribution after 30 steps. They train draft models to be rejected at critical reasoning points so those tokens are sampled from the target model, and report higher end-to-end success on agentic coding benchmarks by training 0.06-0.28% of hosted parameters without changing the target model.

items.title: Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Octopus：面向隐式 KV 多智能体强化学习的一脑多分支架构
items.summary: Octopus is a co-designed serving runtime, memory manager and RL framework that executes long-horizon agent episodes as a GPU-resident DAG over radix cursors, with fork, rewind, read_thread, wait and done primitives for sharing and mounting KV cache. Trained on Qwen3.5-4B, it raises BrowseComp-Plus accuracy under BM25 from 26.0% with 32K ReAct and 32.1% with 143K GRPO to 49.6%, and reports a 21x reduction in cache hijacking.

items.title: SlackBench: Benchmarking Agents on Collaborative Projects Grounded in Real Code Repositories
items.title_zh: SlackBench：在真实代码仓库协作项目中评估智能体
items.summary: SlackBench is a benchmark of 140 queries built from privacy-preserving reenactments of real academic research projects, requiring agents to search multi-party dialogue, inspect evolving GitHub repositories and Google Docs, reconcile stale or conflicting evidence, and abstain on unanswerable questions. Across 33 frontier models and agent harnesses, the best system scores around 80% and most agents fall below 66%.

items.title: Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI
items.title_zh: 适配的进程：AI 中的达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体主导演化
items.summary: The paper develops a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian and agent-directed evolution after environmental change, where agents generate and evaluate behavioral variants and choose how extensively to search. It argues that more search accelerates adaptation, but that misspecified evaluation targets can make additional search converge faster toward the wrong behavior, a risk for recursive self-improvement.

items.title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?
items.title_zh: CompressionBench：你的编码智能体如何压缩 LLM？
items.summary: CompressionBench frames LLM compression as a terminal task in which a coding agent receives a checkpoint, storage limit, inference environment and time budget, then produces compressed weights and executable inference code. Across six agents and six model-size settings, 29 of 36 submissions pass verification, and the lowest-perplexity designs average a 3.4% perplexity increase over BF16 with 77.33% downstream accuracy versus 79.56% for BF16.

items.title: AtariBench: Evaluating Spatiotemporal Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in Atari Gameplay
items.title_zh: AtariBench：评估视觉语言模型在 Atari 游戏中的时空推理
items.summary: AtariBench evaluates vision-language models across 20 Atari 2600 games that require sequential decisions from high-temporal-resolution gameplay, decoupling in-game dynamics from wall-clock inference speed. The authors report that state-of-the-art VLMs often fail to infer object motion and direction, make brittle decisions and over-rely on textual interaction history, and use the benchmark to study memory design and prompting strategies.

items.title: FinEvolveKG: Controlled and Attributable Prompt Evolution for Financial Knowledge Graph Construction
items.title_zh: FinEvolveKG：面向金融知识图谱构建的可控且可归因的提示演化
items.summary: FinEvolveKG is a knowledge-graph construction harness that separates reusable general and persona-policy prompt blocks and confines a reflective optimizer to the persona block, keeping the approved general block byte-stable and every edit attributable. On ticker-disjoint SEC 10-K splits, the complete two-stage block-constrained workflow improves over a frozen prompt baseline by 19.4-30.9% and over an unconstrained full-prompt workflow by 2.2-6.4%.

items.title: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
items.title_zh: 解析强模型到弱模型的 OPD 相对 GRPO 的计算效率
items.summary: The paper compares on-policy distillation (OPD) with GRPO by measuring held-out accuracy against training FLOPs across task difficulty, model size and domain. It finds that OPD generally loses to GRPO in accuracy per training FLOP with an external post-trained teacher, but when the teacher is the student's own GRPO checkpoint, OPD recovers that checkpoint's math accuracy with 50 times fewer distillation FLOPs, and multi-teacher OPD reaches joint GRPO performance on a two-domain mix with 42.0% fewer total FLOPs.

items.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
items.title_zh: XStack：面向机器学习代码仓库迁移的基准
items.summary: XStack is a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories from PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs to JAX on Google TPUs, grading results against the source repository's published outcome. Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%.

items.title: CoRA-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation by Context Selectors Under Token Budgets
items.title_zh: CoRA-Bench：在 token 预算下评估上下文选择器的证据保留能力
items.summary: CoRA-Bench evaluates whether context selection methods preserve the evidence needed to answer a query under shared token budgets, comparing truncation, BM25, dense retrieval, reranking, LLMLingua-2 and Provence on BABILong, LOONG, NoLiMa and LongMemEval. It finds task-dependent tradeoffs, with method rankings varying across evidence types and between evidence recall and downstream accuracy.

items.title: How reliable is an embedding of the seabed? Repeat-look measurement of frozen encoders on synthetic aperture sonar
items.title_zh: 海底嵌入有多可靠？合成孔径声呐上冻结编码器的重复观测测量
items.summary: The paper treats embeddings of synthetic-aperture sonar imagery as repeat measurements and measures the repeat-look reliability of a frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 encoder. Standard single-look metrics and a coral linear probe (AUC 0.93) remain stable, yet the embeddings' distance-based intraclass correlation is only 0.20, so patch-identity uses such as cross-pass retrieval fail while habitat-level classification still works.

items.title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement with Statistical Guarantees
items.title_zh: 具有统计保证的可信递归自我改进
items.summary: TRUST adapts an online multiple-hypothesis-testing procedure to gate updates in recursive self-improvement, controlling the rate of false evolution across rounds while an LLM analyzes historical context to decide how much evidence is needed. On HotpotQA, DROP and APPS with DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen-3.8-Flash, it cuts the average ratio of accepted inferior updates from 45.59% under a greedy gate to 2.78% while achieving higher final scores than statistical-gate baselines.

items.title: LocateAnyMesh: Grounding 3D Mesh Queries in 2D Images with Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: LocateAnyMesh：用视觉语言模型在二维图像中定位三维网格查询
items.summary: LocateAnyMesh is a vision-language model that takes a textured 3D mesh as part of its prompt, using a frozen 3D encoder and a learned connector to place mesh tokens alongside image and instruction tokens. LAM-Select improves localization on real-image suites and the official BOP YCB-V evaluation without rendered query views or object-specific fine-tuning.

items.title: From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles
items.title_zh: 从自然语言到精确覆盖：Zebra 谜题的神经符号方法
items.summary: The framework combines neural semantic parsing with deterministic exact-cover solving: an LLM translates a natural-language Zebra puzzle into structured tool calls that build an exact-cover instance, and a symbolic solver returns a solution or feedback used to refine invalid or under- and over-constrained encodings. The authors report that the hybrid approach consistently outperforms chain-of-thought prompting and recent neuro-symbolic baselines across model scales and families.

items.title: Same Error, Different Recovery: How Delivery Changes LLM Agent Behavior
items.title_zh: 相同错误，不同恢复：错误呈现方式如何影响 LLM 智能体行为
items.summary: A study across 13 open models from 3B to 70B parameters finds that the same tool error can lead to different retry, correction or stop behavior depending on how it is delivered. Retaining the failed exchange in a new user turn avoided severe stopping failures in Llama models and, as an opt-in recovery layer on ToolMaze, raised success on explicit errors by 14.2 points for 7-8B models and 10.5 points for 32-70B models.

items.title: Modular and Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search with Vectorium and kANNolo
items.title_zh: Vectorium 与 kANNolo：模块化高效的近似最近邻搜索
items.summary: Vectorium and kANNolo are open-source Rust libraries that separate vector data management from indexing, supporting dense, sparse and multi-vector representations with 11 encoders and generic HNSW, IVF and two-stage indexes. The authors report state-of-the-art memory-throughput trade-offs, matching Faiss product quantization in accuracy at competitive speed and outperforming Faiss IVF on their benchmarks.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.title_zh: claude-mem：为每个 Agent 提供跨会话持久上下文
items.summary: claude-mem is a TypeScript project that captures an agent's session activity, compresses it with AI and injects relevant context into future sessions, with support for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot and OpenCode among others.

items.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.title_zh: 用 PDD Kit 形式化验证智能体编写的全栈 Web 应用
items.summary: PDD Kit turns developer intent into a Verus specification and tests agent-written full-stack web apps against it, targeting code generated at a scale that is hard for humans to review line by line.

items.title: BlenderFORGE: Framework for Optimizing Reactive 3D-Graphics Editing Ability of MLLMs
items.title_zh: BlenderFORGE：优化多模态大模型反应式 3D 图形编辑能力的框架
items.summary: BlenderFORGE is a trainable data-environment-optimization framework for open-weight MLLM agents that edit Blender scenes by generating Blender Python code, covering object placement, shape-key editing, lighting and materials. It combines perturbation-based data generation, an isolated Blender sandbox with state export and reward computation, and a two-stage pipeline of teacher-trajectory SFT followed by sandbox-reward agentic RL, reporting gains for Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B agents.

items.title: dabingfy-dot/solo-to-team-skills
items.title_zh: solo-to-team-skills：一人统筹多智能体协作的工具包
items.summary: solo-to-team-skills is a human-led multi-agent toolkit with 16 roles, six group templates, four platform bundles, and evidence-based review and handoff, described as letting one person coordinate a team of agents.

items.title: thecoderrrer/ai_manus
items.title_zh: ai_manus：通用 AI 代理系统
items.summary: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI agent system that can run various tools and operations in a sandboxed environment.

items.title: ScottDuncanAI/PID-to-Knowledge-Graph
items.title_zh: PID-to-Knowledge-Graph：把 P&ID 图纸转换为工艺知识图谱
items.summary: PID-to-Knowledge-Graph is a Python Claude skill that converts P&ID PDFs, whether digital or scanned, into a process knowledge graph capturing flow, instruments and control loops.

items.title_zh: 招商局 LionRock AI Lab 开源 Lion-ER-35B-A3B 具身推理模型
items.summary: China Merchants' LionRock AI Lab has open-sourced Lion-ER-35B-A3B, a 3B-active-parameter embodied reasoning model built with a capability-driven data engine. The lab reports that it beat its base model on ten benchmarks.

items.title: LifeVal
items.title_zh: LifeVal：评估 AI 助力日常任务的基准
items.summary: OpenAI introduces LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks such as finding childcare, managing finances and handling government paperwork.

items.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型可证明推理的进展
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team reports progress on a type of cryptographic proof known as a zkSNARK for large language model inference, primarily through a system it calls FlashProve.

items.title: The agentic web is here
items.title_zh: 智能体网络已经到来
items.summary: MIT Technology Review traces the idea of an agentic web back to Tim Berners-Lee's 2001 Semantic Web vision and examines how autonomous software agents are beginning to navigate the internet on users' behalf.

items.title: Tencent Hunyuan's Hyra 2.0 Research Agent Builds Its Own Tools for Proteins, Proofs and Chips
items.title_zh: 腾讯混元 Hyra 2.0 研究智能体为蛋白质、定理证明和芯片自建工具
items.summary: Tencent Hunyuan's Hyra 2.0 research agent builds reusable tools, including a protein design model reported to be 57x faster, force fields, a new quantum code and mathematical results on Petty and Yau.

items.title: AI for scientific discovery: How researchers use Claude
items.title_zh: AI 助力科学发现：研究人员如何使用 Claude
items.summary: Anthropic analyzed 207,000 research sessions to study how Claude is used in science, why some tasks get more use than others, and how AI could speed up discovery.

items.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
items.title_zh: 衡量 AI 智能体如何处理日常湿实验室科学
items.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

items.title: Teaching AI to build scientific models
items.title_zh: 教 AI 构建科学模型
items.summary: In a guest post, Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon and Stefan Wahl discuss how AI is starting to change the scientific modeling process, from construction to interpretation.

items.title: The components of agent memory
items.title_zh: Agent 记忆的组成部分
items.summary: Anthropic explains that for Claude to learn from experience it must decide what is worth remembering before it knows what comes next, and describes how "dreaming" helps the model organize memory and correct mistakes.

items.title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
items.title_zh: Qodo 借助 Codex 将上下文构建进 AI 代码审查
items.summary: Qodo's Codex integration brings company knowledge and coding standards into AI code review so developers can catch P0 issues across repositories before opening a pull request.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
items.title_zh: OpenAI 将收购 Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
items.summary: OpenAI says it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex's tools for building, understanding and reviewing code.

items.title: DriveFoundry: Co-Evolving Data and Model for Efficient Closed-Loop Iteration in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: DriveFoundry：面向自动驾驶高效闭环迭代的数据与模型协同演化
items.summary: DriveFoundry is a closed-loop autonomous-driving framework that couples structured causal data refinement with adaptive inference, building traceable scene-candidate records and using verified model failures to guide annotation. Its 9B Xiaomi-Drive-o1 model reports the lowest ADE@1 on PhysicalAI among tested models, and adaptive inference matches full reasoning performance using only 28% of tokens.
